title: Peak-to-peak
text: Peak-to-peak voltage is the total span from minimum to maximum voltage.

title: Maximum minus minimum
text: Take the maximum voltage and subtract the minimum voltage.

title: Graphing the function
text: The graph of a sinusoid $$5\sin(Bt)-2$$ oscillates about $$y=-2$$ between the values $$y=-7$$ and $$y=3$$\n##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: An even cosine function that is shifted vertically negative 2 units and has an amplitude of 5, oscillating between -7 and 3.
